messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Compulsory and pre-school education and Children in Hesse during the 1960s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Hessen historische Statistik 1960 Volksschulen Schüler Kindergärten statistische Berichte
Hessisches Statistisches Landesamt historische Jahrbücher 1960 Schulen Kindergarten
GESIS histat Hessen 1960 Schüler Vorschule Bevölkerung Kinder Daten

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"General Education Schools in the Federal Republic of Germany, 1949–2010 (Allgemeinbildende Schulen in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland)","url_or_doi":"https://histat.safe-frankfurt.de/index.php/en/project/details/8F1AA269FF934FEC3762415BE89DDA5A","justification":"Highly relevant historical dataset covering compulsory education, primary schools, secondary schools, school enrollment, and preschool education in Germany from 1949 to 2010. Includes state-level data for Hesse (Hessen) throughout the 1960s. Particularly useful for examining the number of schools, classes, pupils, and school kindergartens (Schulkindergärten)."},{"title":"Historical Statistics: School Kindergartens, Elementary Schools, and General Education by German Federal State, 1949–2010","url_or_doi":"https://histat.safe-frankfurt.de/index.php/en/project/tables/8F1AA269FF934FEC3762415BE89DDA5A","justification":"Direct access to historical statistical tables covering educational institutions by German federal state, including Hesse. Particularly relevant tables include 1.1.02 (school kindergartens, 1956–2010), 1.1.04 (elementary schools, 1949–2010), and additional tables on general education. Provides comparable annual data for the 1960s, making it one of the strongest sources for investigating compulsory and preschool education in Hesse."},{"title":"Historical Development of Population and Economy in Hesse, 1945–2016 (Daten zur Entwicklung von Bevölkerung und Wirtschaft in Hessen ab 1945 bis 2016)","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistischebibliothek.de/mir/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/HEHeft_derivate_00007852/Z2_2j16_A.pdf","justification":"Official historical statistical publication from the Hessian Statistical Office. Includes education statistics covering pupils in general education schools from 1948 to 2016, with information on female pupils, teachers, and different educational categories. Contains historical observations for the entire 1960s and is particularly useful for analyzing compulsory schooling and the development of the school-age population in Hesse."},{"title":"Historical Statistics on Pupils in General Education Schools in Hesse, 1948–1979","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistischebibliothek.de/mir/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/HEHeft_derivate_00007853/Z2_2j16.pdf","justification":"Official dataset published by the Hessian Statistical Office, providing annual pupil counts for general education schools from 1948 onward. Includes the 1960s and distinguishes between primary and lower-secondary pupils, intermediate schools, grammar schools, and special education. Particularly valuable for studying compulsory education enrollment and changes in the composition of schoolchildren in Hesse."},{"title":"The Development of the Educational System in Germany: Comprehensive Schools, 1960–2000 (Bildungsentwicklung in Deutschland)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.8220","justification":"GESIS historical education dataset covering the development of German education between 1960 and 2000. Includes time series on schools, classes, pupils, teachers, and educational expenditure, with additional historical observations beginning in the 1950s. Contains information on primary and lower-secondary education as well as kindergarten and preschool classes. Useful for comparing educational developments in Hesse with broader German trends, although not all series are specific to Hesse."},{"title":"Historical Statistics: Educational Development in Germany, 1950–2000","url_or_doi":"https://histat.safe-frankfurt.de/index.php/en/project/tables/BCE3FBD7427EBA36273554764EC22DB1","justification":"Historical statistical tables from the GESIS educational development dataset. Includes series A4.03 on pupils in primary and lower-secondary schools from 1952 to 2000 and A4.05 on children in kindergarten or preschool classes and elementary schools from 1950 to 2000. These data cover the 1960s and provide contextual evidence about compulsory and preschool education. Geographic applicability to Hesse should be checked for individual tables."},{"title":"Hessian Statistical Information System (HESIS)","url_or_doi":"https://statistik.hessen.de/unsere-zahlen/datenbank-hesis","justification":"Official statistical database maintained by the Hessian Statistical Office, covering education, population, and other socioeconomic indicators. Allows geographic filtering at state, district, and municipal levels and supports Excel downloads. Some historical series extend into the 1970s, making it useful for examining later developments in child populations and education in Hesse. However, coverage of the 1960s is not established, so it is primarily a supplementary source."}]}
